arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/tmp/ncheck.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
for f in /workspace/examples/*.in.native; do
  exp="${f/.in./.out}"
  echo "=== $f"
  if /workspace/tmp/engine2 < "$f" > /workspace/tmp/nat.out 2> /workspace/tmp/nat.err; then
    if diff <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < /workspace/tmp/nat.out) <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < "$exp") >/dev/null; then echo MATCH; else echo DIFF; diff <(cat /workspace/tmp/nat.out) <(cat "$exp") | head -20; fi
  else
    echo "FAILED: $(cat /workspace/tmp/nat.err)"
  fi
done
EOF
bash /workspace/tmp/ncheck.sh
